name: spellkave_can_i
label: Can I
description: Ask a running world whether one body may perform one action on one target now, and which admission check decides. Calls the world's probe. Does not evaluate a predicate, select a template, or perform the act. admitted and disclosed are reported side by side.

as.description: The body the question is about, as its authored entity key or its entity id.

anyOf.description: An authored entity key, entity id, or world.

target.description: The target of the attempt, as an authored key, entity id, or target reference.

args.description: Literal manipulation arguments for the probe. Supply the same selected items and either fresh expected_participants or participant_context as the intended dispatch; can-i does not compose a participant context.

expect.description: Closed-door expectation. A differing answer is a rejection.

promptSnippet: Ask the world whether this actor may perform this action, and which check decides

examples.description: ask whether the hero may cast mark

examples.command: sk can-i core/cast_mark --as core/bystander --target core/mark --expect refused
